description: This file defines the Image model class for managing project images within the Goteo platform. It includes methods for retrieving, updating, and reordering images related to projects, as well as handling image URLs and image galleries.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: Represents images associated with projects, providing functionality to retrieve, save, reorder, and generate URLs for project images.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the image object; currently a placeholder returning true.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the image object; currently a placeholder returning null.

methods.name: get_image_resource_url
methods.description: Generates a full URL for the given image URL, handling different URL formats and base paths.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves images for a specific project and optional section, returns an array of image objects.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of image names and URLs for a project and optional section.

methods.name: getGalleries
methods.description: Retrieves multiple galleries for a project, optionally filtered by section.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the main image for a project based on a provided gallery or image object.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Moves an image up in order within a project section.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Moves an image down in order within a project section.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Calculates the next order number for adding a new image to a project.

methods.name: sections
methods.description: Returns predefined sections for project image galleries.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Returns the link for the image.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the image.
